description: Creates an account. Setup step, counts nothing in v0.
Links the place the code lives, like GitHub. Setup step, counts nothing in v0.
Points the platform at one repo to build. Setup step, counts nothing in v0.
The build runs for the first time. Setup step, counts nothing in v0.
A stage of the build runs. User level only: at org level, pipelines_run from CI replaces it.
The checks on the code run. User level only: at org level, pipelines_run from CI replaces it.
A whole run passes. User level only: at org level, pipelines_run from CI replaces it.
A run breaks: the product caught a bug. User level only: at org level, pipelines_run from CI replaces it.
Reads the documentation. Weak usage signal: anyone can read docs.
Brings a colleague into the organization: one person's experiment becoming a team's tool.
Splits work across many machines at once. Costs real compute; only teams with big, slow test suites bother.
Looks at what the plans cost. Interest in paying, weaker than a trial.
Switches onto a paid plan for a trial period. Stronger than a pricing visit: they hand over details and use the paid plan.
One pipeline run in the CI records: the organization's real usage. CI records have no user_id, so org level only.
